facts.fact: EAAIF says Liquid Intelligent Technologies operates a 110,000 km cross-border terrestrial fibre network across 25 countries including Kenya, South Africa and Zimbabwe, and on 2026-08-05 committed a USD 50 million loan to refinance and maintain it; Zimbabwe is named only as one of the countries, and no end of a link is given.
